---
title: Ordinary page
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      # A page with no `draft` key must be untouched: no banner, and no
      # `quarto:status` meta tag either. The positive selector keeps this
      # from passing vacuously if the render ever produced an empty file.
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["body"]
        - ["div#quarto-draft-alert", 'meta[name="quarto:status"]']
---

An ordinary page.
